answer: Nonce-bound worklog attestation. Each identity must publish a fresh voyage of signed task traces whose hashes chain to a server-issued random seed, so replaying old work fails verification. The rule requires embedding a distinct quartz timestamp token per epoch into every trace, making each identity’s record unrepeatable and cross-checkable by any peer. A mirror copy of one identity’s traces cannot satisfy a new seed, forcing attackers to rerun the full computation per fake identity at linear compute and storage cost.
